topic: The Magic of Text-to-Image AI: Diffusion, CLIP, and the Math Behind the Art
target_audience: University students with a basic background in linear algebra and probability.

sections.title: Introduction: The Image Synthesis Pipeline
lecture_lines: Text prompts turn into images via two main systems.
CLIP understands the connection between text and images.
Diffusion gradually creates images from static white noise.

Animate a connecting arrow from the 'Input Prompt' box to the 'Neural Pipeline' box.

sections.title: CLIP: Mapping Language to Visual Space
lecture_lines: CLIP maps text and images to shared vector space.
Aligned vectors share similar directions, showing semantic similarity.
Cosine similarity measures how close these vectors are.
animations: Show two labels: 'Text Space' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/photograph.svg] (#FFFFE0) and 'Visual Space' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg] (#FFFFE0) in row B.
Fade in a central block labeled 'CLIP Embedding' in column 5, row E.
Animate vectors flowing from 'Text Space' and 'Visual Space' into the central 'CLIP Embedding' block.

sections.title: The Diffusion Process: Math as an Artist
lecture_lines: Diffusion adds noise to an image, destroying its structure.
A neural network learns to predict this added noise.
Reversing this process recovers the image from noise.
animations: Display a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/canvas.svg] of pure random [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/noise.svg] (#808080) at column 5, row B.
Iteratively transform [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/noise.svg] into a shape at column 5, row E using a series of 5 sequential step frames.
Highlight the final shape on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/canvas.svg] with a glowing outline as the 'Clear Image' completes.

sections.title: Guidance: Bridging Text and Noise
lecture_lines: We use text prompts to guide the denoising process.
Guidance shifts the model towards the desired output image.
This bridge connects abstract text to visual noise.
animations: Place 'Text Prompt' (#FF69B4) at column 5, row B represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/keyboard.svg] and 'Noise' (#808080) at column 5, row E.

Show a bright glowing trace moving from the noise [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg] toward the prompt to illustrate the guidance shift.

sections.title: Synthesis and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Iterative denoising refines noise into a coherent image.
The process uses 50 to 100 small steps.
The final result is art born from noise.
